chapters.label: Stuttgart, live
chapters.text: Stuttgart, 2024. Spain, in red, play Germany, in white, in the Euro quarter-final. Dani Olmo came on for injured Pedri. Yamal cuts inside and rolls it across. Nobody follows Olmo. First time... past Neuer! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Olmo runs from deep, behind Germany's midfield. Yamal pulls two defenders. Olmo arrives unmarked and sweeps it in without breaking stride.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: How he does it: find the pocket. Stand between the other team's midfield and defence, where nobody is marking you.
